verdict.rationale: This axis applies: a state business-filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled filings, automatic renewals, or programmatic automation. The evidence describes only interactive portal features (Gateway login via OHID, filing-administrator enhancements, OH|TAX online filing and payments) and documents nothing a user could set up to run autonomously in the background. The probes add that the Secretary of State's hosts return 403 even on robots.txt.
